summary:
FarmPulse is a comprehensive agricultural management platform designed to empower farmers with data-driven insights. By leveraging NASA POWER satellite data, FarmPulse provides real-time monitoring of weather conditions, crop health, and soil moisture to help farmers make informed decisions.

The app combines advanced satellite imagery analysis with intuitive dashboards, enabling farmers to track their farms and crops throughout the growing season. From planting to harvest, FarmPulse delivers actionable alerts about potential threats like frost, drought, pests, and optimal harvesting windows.

Whether you are managing a small family farm or overseeing large agricultural operations, FarmPulse scales to meet your needs with features like multi-farm support, crop-specific phenology tracking, crop disease identification and intelligent irrigation scheduling enabling farmers to improve upon yield with better informed decisions generated with help of NASA data.
details:
FarmPulse integrates advanced NASA satellite data and Earth observation systems to provide comprehensive smart farming capabilities. These features use real-time and historical satellite imagery, vegetation indices, soil moisture data, and environmental monitoring to help farmers make data-driven decisions.

Demo User: demo@farmpulse.app

Password: FarmPulseDemo2026!

Salient features of FarmPulse:

1. Satellite Imagery Viewer

View live satellite imagery of your farms from multiple NASA satellites:

  • MODIS Terra/Aqua True Color: Natural color imagery at 250m resolution, updated daily
  • VIIRS True Color: High-resolution natural color from NOAA-20 at 500m resolution
  • MODIS NDVI: Vegetation health index visualization at 500m resolution
  • Land Surface Temperature: Surface temperature measurements at 1km resolution

Benefits:

  • Visual monitoring of crop conditions
  • Identification of problem areas in fields
  • Comparison of different spectral bands
  • Historical imagery for trend analysis

Technology: NASA GIBS (Global Imagery Browse Services)

2. Satellite NDVI (Vegetation Health)

Track crop health using the Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) from satellite observations:

Metrics Tracked:

  • NDVI values (0 to 1 scale)
  • Vegetation Condition Index (VCI)
  • Data quality indicators
  • Cloud cover percentages
  • 90-day historical trends

Benefits:

  • Early detection of crop stress
  • Objective health monitoring
  • Historical trend analysis
  • Comparison across growth stages

Technology: MODIS satellite with 16-day revisit cycle

3. Soil Moisture from SMAP

Monitor soil moisture levels using NASA's Soil Moisture Active Passive (SMAP) satellite:

Measurements:

  • Surface soil moisture (0-5cm depth)
  • Root zone soil moisture (0-100cm depth)
  • 30-day historical data
  • Data quality indicators

Benefits:

  • Better irrigation scheduling
  • Water conservation
  • Drought monitoring
  • Root zone water availability tracking

Technology: SMAP L-band radar at 9km resolution, 3-day revisit

4. Natural Disaster Monitoring

Real-time tracking of natural events and disasters near your farms:

Events Monitored:

  • Wildfires
  • Floods
  • Severe storms (hurricanes, cyclones)
  • Droughts
  • Earthquakes
  • Volcanic activity

Alert System:

  • Critical: Events within 50km
  • High: Events within 150km
  • Medium: Events within 300km
  • Low: Events within 500km

Benefits:

  • Early warning system
  • Risk assessment
  • Emergency preparedness
  • Insurance documentation

Technology: NASA EONET (Earth Observatory Natural Event Tracker)

5. Crop Disease Identification & India Market Watch

Detect visible disease, pest damage, and nutrient stress early with a vision model. FarmPulse analysis of indicative modal mandi prices, arrivals, and demand for major crops.

6. Enhanced Alert System

The alert system now includes natural disaster alerts:

  • Automatic checks for nearby natural events
  • Severity-based notifications
  • Distance calculations from farms
  • Links to official sources
  • Integration with existing weather and crop alerts
